text_block_list.text:
Now, Trainer, to the beginning of the
Classic
Triple Crown, the Satsuki Sho!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
choice_data_list: I know you can do it!

text_block_list.text:
Naturally. But first, to put on some
proper attire
to greet my audience.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Hello, fans of mine and fans-to-be! How

wonderful it is to see you here!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Allow me to introduce today's
supporting cast.
The one standing
before me is...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Адмайр Вега, aka Ayabe!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Ngh...
text_block_list.name: Адмайр Вега

text_block_list.text:
Адмайр Вега gets dragged out of her
hiding spot
in the shadows.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Such a glum face... What troubles you,
Ayabe?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Gah?! You mean to say your name is not
Ayabe?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Then, your name must be... Love! You
are truly
love in and of itself!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: One and all, meet Love! Lala lala. ♪
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Just stick with Ayabe!
text_block_list.name: Адмайр Вега

text_block_list.text:
And I told you to leave me be. Why are
you doing
this?
text_block_list.name: Адмайр Вега

text_block_list.text:
Oh, don't be like that. I thought we had
an
understanding, you and I, after all the
running
we've done together.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I already know everything about you.
Yes... You
are an Umamusume at Tracen
Academy!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
And you strive for victory in the Satsuki
Sho!
How's that? Hahaa!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: ...That sums up what I know.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: I'd call that only the bare minimum.
text_block_list.name: Адмайр Вега

text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha! So, you had reserved the
rest for
today, then!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Then let us walk side by side to the
track, o rival
of mine!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
What is it with you? I was trying to
concentrate!
text_block_list.name: Адмайр Вега

text_block_list.text:
But you won't stop me! Nothing will stop
me!
Because I'm... not racing for myself.
text_block_list.name: Адмайр Вега

text_block_list.text: Oh?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Heheh. ♪ Well then, shall we?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Т.М. Опера О elegantly approaches
Адмайр Вега
and leads her away.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The curtain rises for the first act of our
legend!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
